title: Iff split for IMO 2026 Q4: MulanCanGuarantee θ iff θ = 180/n for some n ≥ 2
intent: Assemble the triangle-game headline result — Mulan can force a winning angle θ from every valid triangle exactly when θ = 180/n for some integer n ≥ 2 — by rewriting the markedness predicate into the arithmetic form with `arithmetic_bridge`, then splitting the biconditional with `constructor`. The necessity direction (guarantee ⇒ marked) refutes the win from an unmarked complement using `safe_start` and `safe_nonwin`; the sufficiency direction (marked ⇒ guarantee) hands the witness n to `universal_win`.

parent.name: main_theorem
parent.statement:
theorem main_theorem (θ : ℝ) (hθ0 : 0 < θ) (hθ180 : θ < 180) :
    MulanCanGuarantee θ ↔ ∃ n : ℕ, 2 ≤ n ∧ θ = 180 / n := by

children.name: arithmetic_bridge
children.statement:
lemma arithmetic_bridge {θ : ℝ} (h0 : 0 < θ) (h180 : θ < 180) :
    Marked θ 180 ↔ ∃ n : ℕ, 2 ≤ n ∧ θ = 180 / (n : ℝ) := by
children.closed_by: `constructor` on `↔`; the `Marked → ∃` direction derives `1 < m` by `lt_of_mul_lt_mul_right h (le_of_lt h0)` and closes `rw [eq_div_iff (ne_of_gt hmpos)]` + `linarith [heq, mul_comm (m : ℝ) θ]` (lines 54-56); the `∃ → Marked` direction closes `rw [heq]` + `field_simp` (lines 63-64)

children.name: safe_start
children.statement:
lemma safe_start {θ : ℝ} (h0 : 0 < θ) (h180 : θ < 180) (hT : ¬ Marked θ 180) :
    Safe θ ({θ / 2, θ / 2, 180 - θ} : Multiset ℝ) := by
children.closed_by: `refine ⟨isTriangle_triple (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith) (by ring), ?_⟩` for validity (line 72); the two θ/2 angles are shown unmarked by `nlinarith [heq, h0, hm1]` (lines 78, 81), the third angle `180 - θ` by deriving a marked `180` and closing with `exact hT ⟨m + 1, by omega, …⟩` (lines 82-86)

children.name: safe_nonwin
children.statement:
lemma safe_nonwin {θ : ℝ} (hθ : 0 < θ) (hT : ¬ Marked θ 180)
    {s : Multiset ℝ} (hsafe : Safe θ s) : ¬ MulanWins θ s := by
children.closed_by: `suffices h : ∀ t, MulanWins θ t → Safe θ t → False` then induction on `MulanWins`; `win` case `exact hsafe'.2 θ h ⟨1, le_refl 1, by push_cast; ring⟩` (line 100); `move` case `rcases safe_child hθ hT hsafe' hcut with hsL | hsR` (line 103) then `exact ihL hsL` / `exact ihR hsR` (lines 104-105)

children.name: universal_win
children.statement:
lemma universal_win {θ : ℝ} (hθ : 0 < θ) {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (hT : (180 : ℝ) = (n : ℝ) * θ) : MulanCanGuarantee θ := by
children.closed_by: an inner strong induction `Pq` over `q` (`Nat.le_induction`, lines 304-340): base uses `small_angle_finish` (line 121) or `MulanWins.win` (line 122); step builds a cut with `peeling_cut` (line 135) and recurses `ih _ (a - θ) hRtri haθmem haθ0 haθle` (line 147); closed by `exact Pq q hq1 s a hs ha ha0 haq` (line 354)

applicability.goal_shape: A biconditional `P ↔ ∃ n : ℕ, 2 ≤ n ∧ θ = 180 / n`, where `P` is a game reachability predicate (`MulanCanGuarantee θ`) and the right-hand side is an arithmetic existence condition with a side condition `2 ≤ n`. Both directions already exist as named lemmas, and a separate rewrite lemma (`arithmetic_bridge`) converts the intermediate predicate `Marked θ 180` into the arithmetic form so the `rw` fires before the split.
applicability.use_when: both directions already exist as named lemmas whose hypotheses match the theorem's exactly (`0 < θ`, `θ < 180`); the theorem is a genuine biconditional and each direction closes by a single `rw`/`exact` of the corresponding lemma; an intermediate predicate needs a one-to-one bridge to the arithmetic statement, so the split happens on the simpler predicate.
applicability.avoid_when: one direction needs a bespoke argument too large to be worth naming, so the glue grows; the two lemmas are stated over different hypotheses and the hand-off needs extra rewriting; the intermediate predicate has no clean bridge lemma and the rewrite does not fire; the biconditional is really a one-way implication.

consequences: `constructor` on `↔` creates exactly two goals. The necessity direction (`MulanCanGuarantee θ → Marked θ 180`) is proved by contradiction: assume `hT : ¬ Marked θ 180`, build the safe triangle with `safe_start`, obtain a win from `hg`, and refute it with `safe_nonwin`. The sufficiency direction (`Marked θ 180 → MulanCanGuarantee θ`) unpacks the mark as `⟨m, hm, heq⟩`, re-derives `1 < m` from `θ < 180` (lines 393-397, duplicating part of `arithmetic_bridge`) to satisfy `universal_win`'s `2 ≤ n`, and applies `universal_win`. Failure modes: dropping `θ < 180` leaves n = 1 (θ = 180) unexcluded and both `arithmetic_bridge` and the glue's `1 < m` argument fail; if `arithmetic_bridge` is stated over different hypotheses the `rw [← …]` at line 385 does not fire; the `1 < m` re-derivation in the glue (lines 393-397) is a small duplication that must stay in step with `arithmetic_bridge`'s forward direction.
